I recently got my phone battery replaced here and was clearly told at the time of giving the phone that it would come with a 9-month warranty. Based on that assurance, I agreed to the repair.

However, at the time of collecting the phone, when I asked for the warranty bill, the staff completely denied that any such warranty was promised. This was very disappointing and unprofessional.

This is not my first experience with this shop. I have visited multiple times in the past, and on a previous occasion, I was given a warranty bill after the repair. Because of that, I trusted that the same would be followed this time as well, but it was not.

featured_reviews.name: Nimi Jayan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Please never visit this store. It is a fraudulent shop that cheats customers of their hard-earned money.
I went there to get a screen guard for my OnePlus Pad Go 2. Initially, I was told the price was ₹200. However, after the screen guard was applied, they suddenly claimed the price was ₹2,200.
When I proceeded to pay by card, they increased the amount by another ₹500 on the card machine. I immediately questioned this, after which they said it was a “mistake” and re-entered the earlier amount.
Later, when I checked with other stores, I found that the same screen guard costs around ₹600. When I confronted them about the overpricing, they tried to justify it by saying it comes with a 3-month warranty—for a screen guard, which is unreasonable.
To make matters worse, they refused to give a proper bill. Only after I raised my voice did they hand over a handwritten payment slip, not a valid invoice.
I am planning to file a complaint in consumer court against this unethical practice. Such fraudulent shops and salespeople should not be allowed to operate and cheat consumers.
If anyone else has faced similar issues at this store, please reach out to me. I would be happy to file a joint complaint.
